content.value: The probability that a husband and wife be alive 30 years from now are given by 0.7 and 0.8 respectively. Find the probability that in 30 years (i) both (ii) neither (iii) at least one will be alive (iv) if there are 10,000 couples, how many couples you expected in which both are alive.
